entry.title: New: a page per EU authority, starting with ENISA: finances, staff, contracts, tasks per act, documents
entry.summary: With charts of where ENISA's money comes from, the Commission's agreements, its staff and the outlook under the Cybersecurity Act 2 proposal, and our first analysis.

entry.title: New: a page on the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre (ECCC), the EU body that funds cybersecurity
entry.summary: Its budget by programme from 2021 to the draft plan for 2029, how fast it pays, where the money goes by area and country, its staff, its tasks under each act and its documents, with our first analysis.

entry.title: The Regulation Desk now opens with what is new since the last edition, and says what a document contains
entry.summary: A story counts as new on the day it reaches the site, not on the date of its document; where we have reviewed a Council or Parliament document, its summary is the line under the headline; the edition is built after the morning check of the EU sources, and nothing appears twice.
